title: Modular cockpit controls
description: Standalone control trees; instantiate only the selected part at its socket.
frame: ISO 8855: x forward, y left, z up; metres; radians. The .glb itself uses glTF axes (+Y up, +Z forward, +X left): gltf(x,y,z) = iso(y,z,x).
origin: Every part_<id> root is its own mounting origin. +Z is the mounting normal, +X forward.
rest_pose: All node rotations are identity at rest; a node's origin is its joint pivot. Joint values are offsets from the rest pose (0 = as modelled).
notes: All parts overlap at their own mounting origin; extract part_<id> and its descendants, not the entire scene.
Interaction vectors stay explicitly ISO in extras; joint axes in GLB are converted to glTF by assetgen.
No actions are executed by this asset. Physics/game wiring belongs to C0/C1/P2/P3.
